gloss_en: I want to send an email to the manager now
notes: [tech] email→imiːl (conservative ʿAsīr has no mid /eː/; total nativisation projects to nearest [iː] — cf. sharqiyya imeːl). frame أَبِي/الْحِين peninsular (asiri2009). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: عِنْدِي meeting مُهِمّ بَعْد صَلَاة الظُّهْر
raw: عندي meeting مهم بعد صلاة الظهر
ipa: ˈʕindiː miːtinɡ muˈhimm ˈbaʕd ˈsˤɑlaː aɬˤˈɬˤuhr
gloss_en: I have an important meeting after the noon prayer
notes: [work] meeting→miːtinɡ (/ŋ/→[nɡ]). native ظ in الظُّهْر → [ɬˤ] VOICELESS lateral emphatic — the Rijāl Almaʿ archaism kept distinct from ض[ɮˤ] (watson2011 p.428; asiri2009; alazraqi2010). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: laptop حَقِّي خَرْبَان وْ الشَّاشَة مَكْسُورَة
raw: laptop حقي خربان و الشاشة مكسورة
ipa: labtub ˈħaqqiː xarˈbaːn w ˈʃʃaːʃa makˈsuːra
gloss_en: my laptop is broken and the screen is cracked
notes: [tech] laptop→labtub (/p/→[b]). حَقّ possessive with /q/ RETAINED [ħaqqiː] — southwestern sedentary qaf, NOT Najdi [ɡ] (asiri2009). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: نَزَّلْت file بَسّ download بَطِيء وَاجِد
raw: نزلت file بس download بطيء واجد
ipa: nazˈzalt fil ˈbass dawnlaud bɑˈtˤiːʔ ˈwaːdʒid
gloss_en: I downloaded a file but the download is very slow
notes: [tech] file→fil; download→dawnlaud (/aʊ/→[aw]). وَاجِد southwestern intensifier (watson2002; asiri2009). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: I forgot the password of the email
notes: [tech] password→baswuːrd; email→imiːl (no [eː]→[iː]). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: mobile حَقِّي ضَاع مِنِّي فِي السُّوق
raw: mobile حقي ضاع مني في السوق
ipa: mubil ˈħaqqiː ˈɮˤaːʕ ˈminniː ˈfiː ˈssuːq
gloss_en: my mobile got lost from me in the market
notes: [tech] mobile→mubil. native ض in ضَاع → [ɮˤ] VOICED lateral emphatic (watson2011 p.428); ق in السُّوق RETAINED [q] (asiri2009). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: I watched a video on the internet
notes: [daily] video→fidiu (/v/→[f]). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: charger حَقِّي مُو زَيْن وْ الْبَطَّارِيَّة خَلْصَت
raw: charger حقي مو زين و البطارية خلصت
ipa: ʃaːrdʒar ˈħaqqiː ˈmuː ˈzajn w lbɑtˤtˤɑːˈrijja ˈxalsˤɑt
gloss_en: my charger is not good and the battery is empty
notes: [tech] charger→ʃaːrdʒar (/tʃ/→[ʃ], loan /dʒ/ kept). Gulf-shared مُو negation, زَيْن (asiri2009). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: I paid cash not by card
notes: [commerce] cash→kaʃ. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: أَبِي أَشْتَرِي car بَسّ غَالِي وَاجِد
raw: أبي أشتري car بس غالي واجد
ipa: ˈʔabiː ˈʔaʃtariː kaːr ˈbass ˈɣaːliː ˈwaːdʒid
gloss_en: I want to buy a car but it is very expensive
notes: [automotive] car→kaːr. وَاجِد southwestern intensifier (asiri2009). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: this model is new and automatic
notes: [automotive] model→mudil; automatic→aatumatik. native ج in جَدِيد → [dʒ] (ǧīm reflex; asiri2009). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: الدُّكْتُور قَال إِنِّي مَرِيض لَازِم آخُذ medicine
raw: الدكتور قال إني مريض لازم آخذ medicine
ipa: addukˈtuːr ˈqaːl ˈʔinniː maˈriːɮˤ ˈlaːzim ˈʔaːxuð midisin
gloss_en: the doctor said I am sick and must take medicine
notes: [daily] medicine→midisin. native ق in قَال RETAINED [q]; ض in مَرِيض → [ɮˤ] voiced lateral emphatic (watson2011 p.428; asiri2009). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: the car went for a service in the morning
notes: [automotive] loan سَرفِيس 'service (station)' → saˈrfiːs (/v/→[f]); attested car-register loan [sarfiːs] (Holes 2004). pipeline reads the vocalised loan natively and matches. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: I paid cash, there are no problems
notes: [commerce] loan كَاش 'cash' → kaːʃ, matches attested [kaːʃ] (Holes 2004). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: the car has a puncture, I must fix it
notes: [automotive] loan بَنشَر 'puncture' (< Eng. puncture) → banʃar, matches attested [banʃar] (Holes 2004). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: my mobile is lost
notes: [tech] loan موبايل 'mobile'. Pipeline emits [almuːbaːjil] reading و as [uː]; this is CORRECT here — Rijāl Almaʿ is conservative and NON-monophthongising (diphthongs retained, no [oː] in inventory; asiri2009), so the mid vowel of attested Gulf [moːbaːjil] has no home and [uː] is the right projection. Contrast ar-SD where [oː] exists and the same output is known-wrong. native ض ضَاع → [ɮˤ] (watson2011 p.428). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: I have a new television in the house
notes: [daily] loan تلفزيون 'television'. Pipeline emits [tilifizjuːn] (و→[uː]); CORRECT here — no [oː] in the conservative inventory, so [uː] not the Gulf [tilifizjoːn]. diphthong retained الْبَيت→[bajt] (asiri2009). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: how are you my son
notes: [arabizi] Latin-script Arabic (7=ح/ħ). Spells كِيف حَالَك يَا وَلَدِي. Pipeline has no Arabizi path; ipa hand-derived as the Rijāl Almaʿ reading (asiri2009). table: n/a

sentence: wein ru7t? ana kint fi al-souq
raw: wein ru7t? ana kint fi al-souq
ipa: ˈwiːn ˈruħt ˈʔanaː ˈkint ˈfiː ˈssuːq
gloss_en: where did you go? I was in the market
notes: [arabizi] Latin-script Arabic (7=ح/ħ). Spells وِين رُحْت؟ أَنَا كِنْت فِي السُّوق. Pipeline has no Arabizi path; ipa hand-derived, ق RETAINED [q] in السُّوق (asiri2009). table: n/a

gloss_en: I have an appointment with the judge tomorrow
notes: [arabizi] Latin-script Arabic (3=ع/ʕ, 9=ق/q). Spells عِنْدِي مَوْعِد عِنْد الْقَاضِي بُكْرَة. Pipeline has no Arabizi path; ipa hand-derived — ق RETAINED [q] and ض of القاضي → [ɮˤ] voiced lateral emphatic (watson2011 p.428; asiri2009); diphthong مَوْعِد→[mawʕid]. table: n/a
